tier_should.rationale: Novel nationwide biodiversity panel with credible causal shocks; links economic activity to species decline and regulation mitigation; strong identification and policy relevance; excellent fit for top field or general-interest A if robustness and mechanisms are persuasive.

tier_will.rationale: High-profile authors, NBER visibility, timely topic. Environmental economics focus may limit general journals; likely AEJ Applied/JAERE/REStat. Placement depends on ecological data credibility and identification across channels.
